archetypes.name: orchestrator-wait-contract
archetypes.rationale: The change is docs-only but affects /design wait behavior and no-progress loops.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for prompt-contract risk in /design background waits. Check that repeated non-empty notifications cannot trigger probes, ScheduleWakeup, Monitor, prose loops, or premature parsing. Verify that completion still proceeds when the terminal sentinel exists, and that test coverage matches pinned literals. Cite every claim with file:line evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
